messages:
marta: support ticket from OmniBase — they need streaming chat that emits discrete JSON frames for their analytics pipeline + in-stream function_call hints. They want resumable streams and a final summary event.

marta: Key requirements they wrote: 1) NDJSON or length-prefixed frames; 2) inline function_call metadata tied to frames; 3) client can resume from seq on reconnect; 4) lightweight validation and clear error frames.

devon: Thanks. Deal size? priority?

support-bot: OmniBase: strategic mid-market. Potential add-on revenue if delivered in 6-8 weeks.

sarah: Tech note: we already stream tokens and emit function_call metadata, but not framed JSON or seq-based resume. Resume implies short-term retention or ephemeral replay.

sarah: Quick scope options: Minimal - emit a single "structured_complete" envelope when a valid JSON completes (no resume, no server validation). ETA ~4-6 weeks. Full - NDJSON frames + seq + server warnings/errors + resume window. ETA ~10-12 weeks.

kevin: For prioritization: mark Minimal as P0 for OmniBase if sales confirms ACV impact. Devon, confirm with account.

devon: Confirmed ACV impact. Sales requests committed delivery window for Minimal.

sarah: I'll draft a short spec with example frame format and acceptance criteria. Example frame: { "event_type":"frame", "seq":10, "body": {"type":"entity","value":"x@o.com"} }

marta: I'll ask OmniBase to attach schema + small sample stream to the ticket.

kevin: Triage: create backlog item for Minimal scope with acceptance criteria, tag sales-critical, owners: @sarah (spec/impl), @marta (customer tests), @kevin (rollout).

support-bot: backlog item created: https://redwood.internal/board/IN-4601

sarah: I'll open the spec PR today and include perf guardrails.

kevin: Thanks team — keep updates brief in this thread.
